definitions: Fleshy, typically large fruit of a climbing plant, especially a melon, pumpkin, or squash.
A dried, hollowed-out gourd shell, used as a container or utensil.
Any climbing or trailing plant of the family Cucurbitaceae, which includes squashes, cucumbers, and melons.
examples: The market stall was piled high with colourful gourds.
She used dried gourds to make decorative bowls.
Many types of gourds are cultivated for food.
